title: GunsBySSSomSo
description: Five(Maybe more) guns in datapack.Just for practice.(it's crossbow)
body:
# 简体中文
你也许想过，TaCZ和Superb Warface那样的枪械为什么仅限于1.20.1-，为什么1.21+就没有枪械模组呢？你或许只是想要一把强力的远程武器，却被支持版本吓退，没关系，GBS（GunsBySSSomSo）来帮你！

本数据包为我的世界加入了三把（未来将会更多）枪械（使用弩）：

M1014（使用指令```/function shanmugunge:bro_givemem1014```获取 为霰弹枪）

MP5（使用指令```/function shanmugunge:bro_givememp5```获取 为冲锋枪）

M250（使用指令```/function shanmugunge:bro_givemem250```获取 为机枪）

AWM（使用指令```/function shanmugunge:bro_givemeawm```获取 为狙击枪）

Glock 17（使用指令```/function shanmugunge:bro_givemeg17```获取 为手枪）
注：本数据包如果加入pvp设置生命提升9最佳

提示：数据包版本存在如无后坐力，无法自动装弹等bug，如要体验完整内容，请加入服务器play.dtmc.fun:28874（服务器使用中文）

# English(Translate by Bing)
You may have wondered why guns like TaCZ and Superb Warface are limited to 1.20.1-, and why are there no gun mods in 1.21? You may just want a powerful ranged weapon but are intimidated by the support version, don't worry, GBS (GunsBySSSomSo) is here to help!

This pack adds three (and more to come) firearms (using crossbows) for Minecraft:

M1014 (Use Command```/function shanmugunge:bro_givemem1014``` to get for a shotgun)

MP5 (Use Command```/function shanmugunge: bro_givememp5``` to get for SMG)

M250 (Use Command```/function shanmugunge: bro_givemem250``` get for machine guns)

AWM (Use Command```/function Shanmugunge: bro_givemeawm``` Get as a Sniper Rifle)

Glock 17 (Use Command```/function shanmugunge: bro_givemeg17``` to get it as a pistol) Note: This data pack is best if you add PvP to set the health boost by 9

Tips: The datapack version has bugs such as no recoil and cannot automatically reload, if you want to experience the full content, please join the server play.dtmc.fun:28874 (server use Chinese)
